parameters.content:
## WF04 Responsibility

Validates WF03, loads authoritative lead state, routes every final status, persists local decisions, and returns a clean canonical lead.

Identity, scoring, AI classification, messaging, and external CRM calls are outside this workflow.

## Routing Rules

- VIP â†’ Manager Approval; no automatic assignment
- Qualified â†’ Sales Assignment
- Nurture â†’ prepared WF05 handoff
- Unqualified â†’ close / low-frequency policy
- Manual Review â†’ human resolution

## Sales Assignment & Fallback

Active reps below capacity only.

Tiers: service + country; service; country; any available rep.

Within a tier: load ratio, current load, ID. Atomic persistence re-checks capacity; stale selections enter manual assignment.

## VIP Human Approval

VIP routing idempotently ensures an approval record and stops before sales assignment. Automated sales action remains blocked pending a later approved-flow implementation.

## CRM Integration Boundary

Stage A/B persists local CRM routing state only.
Real Odoo API synchronization and CRM failure/recovery edge cases are implemented in a later WF04 stage.

WF04 persists local CRM routing state.
Real Odoo API synchronization remains deferred.
Eligible Qualified and Nurture leads are handed off to WF05 after routing persistence.
No real customer messaging, booking, Odoo synchronization, or SLA handling occurs in WF04.

parameters.jsCode: const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json??{}));const required=[['lead_id',lead.lead_id],['qualification',lead.qualification],['qualification.final_status',lead.qualification?.final_status],['processing',lead.processing],['business',lead.business],['contact',lead.contact],['source',lead.source]];const missing=required.filter(([,v])=>v==null||v==='').map(([k])=>k);if(missing.length)throw new Error('Invalid WF03 handoff: missing '+missing.join(', '));if(!['vip','qualified','nurture','unqualified','manual_review'].includes(lead.qualification.final_status))throw new Error('Invalid WF03 handoff: unsupported qualification.final_status "'+lead.qualification.final_status+'"');lead.processing={...lead.processing,current_workflow:'WF04_routing_crm',next_workflow:null,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};return [{json:lead}];

parameters.query: SELECT $2::jsonb workflow_lead,CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(l) END database_lead FROM (SELECT 1) a LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id=$1::uuid;

parameters.jsCode: const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json.workflow_lead??{}));const db=$json.database_lead;if(!db?.id)throw new Error('Canonical lead not found in leads for lead_id='+(lead.lead_id??'unknown'));const w=(v,f)=>v!==null&&v!==undefined?v:f;lead.lead_id=db.id;lead.source={...lead.source,type:w(db.source,lead.source?.type),external_id:w(db.external_source_id,lead.source?.external_id),received_at:w(db.received_at,lead.source?.received_at)};lead.contact={...lead.contact,name:w(db.name,lead.contact?.name),phone_raw:w(db.phone_raw,lead.contact?.phone_raw),phone_normalized:w(db.phone_normalized,lead.contact?.phone_normalized),email_raw:w(db.email_raw,lead.contact?.email_raw),email_normalized:w(db.email_normalized,lead.contact?.email_normalized),consent:w(db.consent,lead.contact?.consent)};lead.business={...lead.business,company_name:w(db.company_name,lead.business?.company_name),service_interest:w(db.service_interest,lead.business?.service_interest),country:w(db.country,lead.business?.country),industry:w(db.industry,lead.business?.industry),company_size:w(db.company_size,lead.business?.company_size),strategic_account:w(db.strategic_account,lead.business?.strategic_account)};lead.request={...lead.request,message:w(db.message,lead.request?.message)};lead.crm={...(lead.crm??{}),odoo_lead_id:w(db.odoo_lead_id,lead.crm?.odoo_lead_id),stage:w(db.crm_stage,lead.crm?.stage),next_action:w(db.next_action,lead.crm?.next_action)};lead.routing={...(lead.routing??{}),assigned_sales_rep_id:w(db.assigned_sales_rep_id,lead.routing?.assigned_sales_rep_id??null),priority:w(db.priority,lead.routing?.priority??null)};lead.processing={...lead.processing,status:w(db.processing_status,lead.processing?.status),current_workflow:'WF04_routing_crm',next_workflow:null,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};return [{json:lead}];

parameters.query: WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),e AS(SELECT status FROM manager_approvals,i WHERE lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND status IN('pending','approved','rejected') ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1),n AS(INSERT INTO manager_approvals(lead_id,status,requested_at,reason) SELECT (j->>'lead_id')::uuid,'pending',now(),'VIP lead requires manager approval before automated sales action' FROM i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM e) RETURNING status),a AS(SELECT status FROM e UNION ALL SELECT status FROM n LIMIT 1) SELECT i.j lead,COALESCE((SELECT status FROM a),'pending') approval_status FROM i;

WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),u AS(UPDATE leads SET assigned_sales_rep_id=NULL,priority='critical',crm_stage='qualified',next_action='await_manager_approval',processing_status='processing',updated_at=now() FROM i WHERE leads.id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid RETURNING leads.id),e AS(INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at) SELECT u.id,'manager_approval_requested','WF04_routing_crm',$2,jsonb_build_object('final_status',j#>>'{qualification,final_status}','priority',j#>>'{routing,priority}','approval_status',j#>>'{manager_approval,status}'),now() FROM u,i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x WHERE x.lead_id=u.id AND x.event_type='manager_approval_requested')) SELECT i.j lead FROM i,u;

WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),e AS(SELECT s.id,s.name,s.current_load,s.max_load,CASE WHEN NULLIF(j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,service_category}','')=ANY(COALESCE(s.service_categories,ARRAY[]::text[])) AND NULLIF(j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,country}','')=ANY(COALESCE(s.countries,ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 1 WHEN NULLIF(j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,service_category}','')=ANY(COALESCE(s.service_categories,ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 2 WHEN NULLIF(j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,country}','')=ANY(COALESCE(s.countries,ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 3 ELSE 4 END candidate_tier,s.current_load::numeric/NULLIF(s.max_load,0) load_ratio FROM sales_reps s,i WHERE s.active=true AND s.current_load<s.max_load),r AS(SELECT * FROM e ORDER BY candidate_tier,load_ratio NULLS LAST,current_load,id) SELECT i.j lead,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'name',r.name,'candidate_tier',r.candidate_tier,'current_load',r.current_load,'max_load',r.max_load) ORDER BY r.candidate_tier,r.load_ratio NULLS LAST,r.current_load,r.id)FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb)candidates FROM i LEFT JOIN r ON true GROUP BY i.j;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
), candidate AS (
  SELECT
    sr.id,
    sr.name,
    sr.current_load,
    sr.max_load,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(input.j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,service_category}', '') = ANY(COALESCE(sr.service_categories, ARRAY[]::text[]))
       AND NULLIF(input.j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,country}', '') = ANY(COALESCE(sr.countries, ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 1
      WHEN NULLIF(input.j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,service_category}', '') = ANY(COALESCE(sr.service_categories, ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 2
      WHEN NULLIF(input.j#>>'{sales_assignment_context,country}', '') = ANY(COALESCE(sr.countries, ARRAY[]::text[])) THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END AS candidate_tier
  FROM sales_reps sr, input
  WHERE sr.active = true
    AND sr.current_load < sr.max_load
  ORDER BY
    candidate_tier,
    sr.current_load::numeric / NULLIF(sr.max_load, 0) NULLS LAST,
    sr.current_load,
    sr.id
  FOR UPDATE OF sr SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1
), selected AS (
  UPDATE sales_reps
  SET current_load = sales_reps.current_load + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM candidate
  WHERE sales_reps.id = candidate.id
    AND sales_reps.active = true
    AND sales_reps.current_load < sales_reps.max_load
  RETURNING
    sales_reps.id,
    sales_reps.name,
    candidate.candidate_tier,
    sales_reps.current_load,
    sales_reps.max_load
), updated AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET assigned_sales_rep_id = selected.id,
      priority = input.j#>>'{routing,priority}',
      crm_stage = 'qualified',
      next_action = 'sales_follow_up',
      processing_status = 'processing',
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input, selected
  WHERE leads.id = (input.j->>'lead_id')::uuid
  RETURNING leads.id
), event AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, event_type, workflow_name, execution_id, payload, created_at)
  SELECT
    updated.id,
    'sales_assigned',
    'WF04_routing_crm',
    $2,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'rep_id', selected.id,
      'assignment_reason', CASE selected.candidate_tier
        WHEN 1 THEN 'tier_1_service_country_match_lowest_workload'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'tier_2_service_match_lowest_workload'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'tier_3_country_match_lowest_workload'
        ELSE 'tier_4_available_capacity_lowest_workload'
      END,
      'service_category', input.j#>>'{routing,service_category}',
      'country', input.j#>>'{business,country}',
      'priority', input.j#>>'{routing,priority}'
    ),
    now()
  FROM updated, selected, input
)
SELECT
  input.j AS lead,
  selected.id AS assigned_rep_id,
  selected.name AS selected_rep_name,
  selected.candidate_tier,
  selected.current_load,
  selected.max_load
FROM input
LEFT JOIN selected ON true;

parameters.content:
## WF05 Handoff

WF04 invokes WF05 only for follow-up-eligible Qualified and Nurture leads.

Qualified requires:
- successful sales assignment
- processing status = processing
- next_action = sales_follow_up

Nurture requires:
- processing status = processing
- next_action = start_nurture_sequence

VIP awaiting manager approval, Manual Review, manual sales assignment, Unqualified, and completed leads do not enter WF05.

WF05 owns follow-up sequence initialization and scheduled follow-up processing.

Select WF05 manually after import until an instance-specific workflow ID is available.

parameters.query: WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),u AS(UPDATE leads SET assigned_sales_rep_id=NULL,priority=j#>>'{routing,priority}',crm_stage=j#>>'{crm,stage}',next_action=j#>>'{crm,next_action}',processing_status=j#>>'{processing,status}',updated_at=now() FROM i WHERE leads.id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid RETURNING leads.id),e AS(INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)SELECT u.id,j->>'routing_event_type','WF04_routing_crm',$2,jsonb_build_object('final_status',j#>>'{qualification,final_status}','route',j#>>'{routing,route}','priority',j#>>'{routing,priority}','next_action',j#>>'{crm,next_action}'),now()FROM u,i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x WHERE x.lead_id=u.id AND x.event_type=j->>'routing_event_type' AND x.workflow_name='WF04_routing_crm'))SELECT i.j lead FROM i,u;
